issues.reason: A result/extent infinitive has no licensed encoding (the reviewer's own gap), and the parse reified 'trading at …' in exactly the reified-state shape (Member + Experiencer) that Result links to, so the atom is true of the sentence — the trading level is the outcome of the rebound — and well-typed; the alternative (To …) would be worse, since it feeds the seeded PurposeOf bridge and would assert a purpose the text does not state.

This mistakes a coverage gap for a defect: a paired bid/ask quote with no unit has no licensed magnitude form (Measure needs one number and a unit), and the instruction set explicitly prefers omission over mis-slotting ('leave the unrepresentable adverbial out rather than mis-slot it'), so dropping it emits nothing false.

'little changed' is the bare minimizer, which the instruction set's own dial reads as near-zero ('few' -> 0.1), so asserting (Member sk_currency_1 changed) at strength 1.0 — and its dual-emit reified twin (Member sk_change_1 changed) — states as fully true what the sentence says barely held.

An adjunct is decided by the question it answers, and 'briefly' answers how long, not how; the instruction set's parallel case ('more often now') directs that an unrepresentable adverbial be left out rather than mis-slotted into Manner, and there is no numeric duration to carry it.

gaps_confirmed: minimizing degree adverbs ('little', 'hardly', 'barely') — the Degree rule keeps the positive property, which misstates a near-negative
paired bid/ask price quotation ('55.25/29') — no licensed magnitude form for a two-number quote with no unit
comparison-baseline 'from X' ('little changed from Friday') — no oblique designated for a standard of comparison
a bare duration adverb with no number ('briefly') — Measure duration needs a magnitude and unit
result/extent infinitive ('rebounded to trade at …') — the infinitive rules cover purpose and control complements only
new_gaps: no licensed strength band for a minimizer on a property — 0.1 is borrowed here from the quantifier dial's 'few', which is stated for proportions over a class, not for degree on an individual
repair_summary: Dropped (Manner sk_weaken_1 briefly), the mis-slotted duration adverb, recording it as a gap; lowered the strength of both 'changed' assertions — the flat (Member sk_currency_1 changed) and its reified twin (Member sk_change_1 changed) — from 1.0 to 0.1 so the minimizer is not asserted as a full change.
notes: The Degree, Experiencer and Source atoms are left untouched, so the reified state still anchors 'from Friday' and the surface adverb 'little' stays on record.
